components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS,
            DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On read this carries the composed, normalized address (the
            normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' was supplied).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'. On
            create it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and appended
            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional birth date of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed as the owner's age on the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be a 4-digit value that is valid for the owner's city per the fixed
            city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. The value is stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner
            intentionally shares a household with an existing owner (same last
            name and address). When true, the duplicate-household check is
            bypassed and the owner is created anyway.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:

**1. `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Added the `ownerSegment` property to the `OwnerDto` schema as a read-only string enum with the four allowed values (`PREMIUM_METRO`, `PREMIUM_REGIONAL`, `STANDARD_METRO`, `STANDARD_REGIONAL`). This drives the openapi-generator to produce `OwnerDto.OwnerSegmentEnum` at build time, matching the existing pattern used for `ageBand`.

**2. `src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — Wired a `@Mapping` for `ownerSegment` and added the `ownerSegment(Owner)` helper. It reuses the existing `membershipLevel(owner)` and `locality(owner)` logic:
- **TIER** = `PREMIUM` when `membershipLevel >= 3`, else `STANDARD`.
- **AREA** = `METRO` when locality is a known region (NSW/VIC/QLD), else `REGIONAL`.
